description: Starter editing operations; import explicitly and extend with your own voice material.

verbs.name: draft
verbs.description: Turn supplied intent into a candidate draft.
verbs.instructions: Express only the supplied intent. Do not add claims.

verbs.name: proofread
verbs.instructions: Correct spelling, grammar, and punctuation while preserving wording and meaning wherever possible.

verbs.name: shape
verbs.description: Restructure supplied material into a coherent candidate.
verbs.instructions: Improve structure and flow using only the supplied substance.

verbs.name: tighten
verbs.description: Remove avoidable length from supplied text.
verbs.instructions: Remove repetition and unnecessary words without changing meaning.
